newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1997 budget sees inflation up, jobless down.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1997 budget sees inflation up, jobless down.

text.p: Danish consumer prices will rise 2.3 percent in 1997 from an estimated 2.0 percent in 1996 and an actual 2.1 percent last year, according to a draft 1997 state budget published on Tuesday.
The figures are identical to economy ministry forecasts released last week.
The budget, unveiled by Finance Minister Mogens Lykketoft, saw 1997 unemployment at 8.6 percent of the workforce against an estimated 9.0 percent for 1996 and 8.7 percent in June 1996.

After negotiations between the Social Democrat-led centre-left minority coalition government and opposition parties this autumn, parliament is expected to ratify the budget in December. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
